clips.sign-of-cross: In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.
clips.apostles-creed: I believe in God, the Father almighty, Creator of heaven and earth, and in Jesus Christ, his only Son, our Lord, who was conceived by the Holy Spirit, born of the Virgin Mary, suffered under Pontius Pilate, was crucified, died and was buried; he descended into hell; on the third day he rose again from the dead; he ascended into heaven, and is seated at the right hand of God the Father almighty; from there he shall come to judge the living and the dead. I believe in the Holy Spirit, the holy catholic Church, the communion of saints, the forgiveness of sins, the resurrection of the body, and life everlasting. Amen.
clips.our-father: Our Father, who art in heaven, hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done on earth, as it is in heaven. Give us this day our daily bread, and forgive us our trespasses, as we forgive those who trespass against us. And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil. Amen.

clips.hail-mary: Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou amongst women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.

clips.glory-be: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

clips.meditation-1: On the third day, Jesus rises gloriously from the dead. The tomb is empty. The angel proclaims: 'He is not here; He is risen, as He said.'
clips.fatima-prayer: O my Jesus, forgive us our sins, save us from the fires of hell, lead all souls to heaven, especially those most in need of thy mercy.
clips.meditation-2: Forty days after the Resurrection, Jesus ascends into heaven in the sight of His disciples. 'I go to prepare a place for you, that where I am, you also may be.'
clips.mystery-3: Third Mystery: The Descent of the Holy Spirit.
clips.meditation-3: The Holy Spirit descends upon the Apostles and the Blessed Virgin Mary in the form of tongues of fire. They are filled with courage and begin to preach the Gospel.
clips.meditation-4: At the end of her earthly life, the Blessed Virgin Mary is taken up body and soul into heavenly glory. The angels rejoice as their Queen enters paradise.
clips.mystery-5: Fifth Mystery: The Coronation of Mary.
clips.meditation-5: Mary is crowned Queen of Heaven and Earth. She reigns as Mother and Advocate for all her children, interceding for us before the throne of her Son.
clips.hail-holy-queen: Hail, Holy Queen, Mother of mercy, our life, our sweetness, and our hope. To thee do we cry, poor banished children of Eve. To thee do we send up our sighs, mourning and weeping in this valley of tears. Turn then, most gracious advocate, thine eyes of mercy toward us. And after this our exile, show unto us the blessed fruit of thy womb, Jesus. O clement, O loving, O sweet Virgin Mary.
